title: 'Get your bearings' reports straight-line distance/direction to named landmarks even when the current room has no exit in that direction (e.g. at The Cross-Furrow, bearings said Tithing was '1 south and 2 east' but the room's only exits were N/W/E).
where: Hearthlands fields / The Cross-Furrow, 'get your bearings'
